note: Calhoun County Conservation Board park (51 acres) on the northwest shore of North Twin Lake near Manson, on the bike trail that circles the lake. The RV rows sit inland of the park's shore road, with a strip of lakeside cabins and trees between them and the water; sites A1-A30 at the south end are extended-stay. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $25 (all RV site types; $15 tent), FCFS pay-on-site, showers, closed Dec-Apr; added 73 sites, sewer (sites 30-43 full hookup), 14-day limit. Stored 30-amp left (page silent). Waterfront lead: lakefront -> lakeview. Pin is in the lake.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (lakefront -> lakeview, a downgrade per the 2026-11-01 rules): on NAIP (260 m frames, 0.29 m/px) none of the RV pads is within a pad's depth of open shore. The central rows (the pin area) are back-ins between two park drives; the lake-side drive and a strip of cabins, trees and lawn lie between them and the riprap shore, 40-60 m. The northeast row backs onto the county road side, with open lawn, trees and the paved shore trail/drive between it and the water (about 70 m). The south end has the boat ramp, parking and cabins on the lake side of the road. The park's own road and the cabins block on-water; views are filtered through trees, so lakeview. Only the primitive tent sites T1-T20 are called 'Lakefront' by the county. Overpass was down (imagery estimates).
PIN IN THE LAKE: 42.49450,-94.62370 is about 70 m offshore in North Twin Lake. The central pad rows are at about 42.4947,-94.6252 (about 125 m west); suggest 42.4948,-94.6250.

LONG-TERM SITES: 30 of the 73 RV spaces (A1-A30) are 'Extended Stay (stay may exceed 14 days)'; the other 43 are short-term only, so most of the campground sells ordinary nights. Imagery shows dense rows of parked trailers in the south-end loop. Local campground; reported for the seasonal question only.
PHONE MISSING: the camping facility page gives 'Call for Availability 712-297-7131'.
HOOKUPS: stored electric 30 is note prose; no county page gives an amperage. Left as is.
FIT UNCLEAR, keep: no pad lengths posted; on imagery the pads are gravel back-ins roughly 12-15 m deep between the drives, long enough for a 23-ft rig by eye.
